blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The search for a long-term garbage solution remains unresolved, with councilors seeking clearer targets for waste reduction and questioning a proposed P470-million processing system that Vice Mayor Tomas Osmeña insists should cost P250 million. The dispute unfolded during the City Council’s regular session on Tuesday, Oct. 13, when Councilor Joel Garganera questioned the city’s progress in addressing its garbage crisis, while Osmeña defended an earlier proposal that he said he had completed in January. Mayor Nestor Archival, meanwhile, said the P470-million proposal from supplier Suki Trading Corp. did not originate from his office and still required scrutiny, […]...
